title: SEC2: AES cipher re-imports key on every encrypt/decrypt
description: crypto2dev_cipher() always uses the inline key path: it copies ctx->key into init_op.key and sets init_op.key_fd = -1 on every AES-CBC/GCM/CTR operation. The Crypto2DevAesCtx struct (allocated once on SETKEY, correct) stores raw key bytes instead of a KEY fd. For repeated encryption with the same key (e.g., bulk data transfer, TLS record layer), the kernel re-loads the key material on every call. Fix: in crypto2dev_aes_setkey_ctx(), call crypto2dev_key_import() and store the KEY fd in devCtx (as done for RSA/ECC). In crypto2dev_cipher(), set init_op.key_fd to the stored fd, set init_op.keylen = 0, and zero init_op.key. This avoids copying key bytes on every encrypt and lets the kernel reuse the loaded key object.
